description:
A graph spec with a simulated signal, a historian that records and replays it, an alarm with
        operator acknowledge, and the SCADA dashboard cards for both. Replace the source with the real
        device node. Next: create_graph, then validate_graph. Never starts recording or writes.
        Example: compose_historian_dashboard(name="Line 1 historian and alarms").
